# pmon_datasource_liveness (Data Source)

Whether a proxy is currently attached to a datasource.

A datasource stays registered after its proxy goes away, so a row in `pmon_datasources` is not evidence anything is serving it. Assert on `attached` in a `lifecycle` precondition where a change only makes sense against a live datasource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pmon_datasource_liveness" "prod" {
  datasource = "example-prod-rw"
}

# A datasource stays registered after its proxy goes away, so gate changes that only make sense
# against something actually serving traffic.
resource "pmon_column_classification" "prod" {
  datasource = "example-prod-rw"
  columns    = local.pii_columns

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = data.pmon_datasource_liveness.prod.attached
      error_message = "No proxy is attached to example-prod-rw, so its catalog may be stale."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datasource` (String) Datasource to check.

### Read-Only

- `attached` (Boolean) Whether a proxy is attached right now.
- `catalog_synced_at` (String) When a proxy last pushed a catalog. Null means it never has.
- `last_seen_at` (String) When a proxy last checked in.
